source_evidence.frozen_requirement_text: For ships operating in low air temperature, a Polar Service Temperature (PST) shall be specified and shall be at least 10 deg C below the lowest MDLT for the intended area and season of operation in polar waters. Systems and equipment required by this Code shall be fully functional at the PST.

contract.comparisonModel: IF ship_operates_in_low_air_temperature = true, THEN PST_degC shall be specified, PST_degC <= lowest_MDLT_degC - 10, and required_systems_functional_at_PST = true.

oracle_scope: Retained source-backed representation contract plus canonical schema; not full-vessel regulatory compliance

                    SELECT $this
